payload.title: [tenant-app-isolation-3] Gateway projection subscribe is broken for per-app projections: validation rejects them...
payload.description:
AUDIT FINDING tenant-app-isolation-3 (high/correctness, confidence=medium, verify-votes +2/-0)

FILE: apps/server/src/sync/gateway.ts, apps/server/src/server.ts
LINES: gateway.ts:180-186, 1205-1221 (#projections.get), 1248 (#projections.snapshot); server.ts:537-583, 831-837 (gateway gets store.projections only)

WHAT: The gateway holds a single `#projections` registry, wired from `store.projections` (the SHARED registry) at server.ts:837. In per-app mode, app-declared projections are registered ONLY into `perAppRegistries.for(app.id).projections`, and ALL projection writes are dispatched through the per-app registries (#notifyProjections in store.ts:1247-1250). The shared `store.projections` registry therefore never receives a notify and never materializes snapshot rows. On Subscribe (gateway.ts:1206) the gateway looks up the projection in the shared registry: a client subscribing to a per-app projection name gets `auth.forbidden / projectionNotFound`. Even when a name does exist in the shared registry, snapshot() (gateway.ts:1248) reads the shared registry's row state, which is empty in per-app mode.

IMPACT: Per-app projections are effectively unusable over the sync gateway in a multi-app deployment: subscriptions to app-specific projections are rejected, and any projection subscription delivers an empty initial snapshot (live deltas still arrive via the per-app delta listener, so clients silently start from an empty view and never reconcile prior rows). Functional break + confusing state divergence; not a cross-app data leak by itself.

SUGGESTED FIX: Make the gateway projection-aware of the per-app registries: resolve get()/snapshot() against `perAppRegistries.for(this.#appIdFor(client)).projections` instead of the single shared registry, falling back to the shared registry only in single-app mode.
